about: The room page's presence (mark online, the 15 s heartbeat, the leave beacon, away and back with the tab, and Leave) to hooks/use-presence.ts, and its typing signal ("drawing" on a draw step, and what the input bar reports) to hooks/use-typing-action.ts. The table holds for the tree of the commit that added it (git log --diff-filter=A -- scripts/step6/tables/web-presence-typing-hooks.json): later moves take more lines out of the page. From the repo root, with that commit checked out in <folder>: node scripts/step6/web-move-check.mjs scripts/step6/tables/web-presence-typing-hooks.json --root <folder>, and node scripts/step6/hook-order.mjs "apps/web/app/room/[roomId]/page.tsx" --root <folder> --base 15d3ef0 --allow scripts/step6/tables/web-presence-typing-hooks.hooks.json --strict

apps/web/app/room/[roomId]/page.tsx: const { handleLeave } = usePresence({ participantId, convexUrl, router });
const { setTypingAction, handleTypingChange } = useTypingAction({ participantId, myActiveStep });
